  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><a href="/kalpitiya-typical-fishermans-hut-experience">Basic wooden</a> cabin by the Kalpitiya lagoon</h2><h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Simplify your kiteboarding trip in Sri Lanka. Prices start at 41.25€ (p/p)</h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Stay in a cozy wooden hut by Kalpitiya Lagoon with all meals included in a peaceful fishing village. Enjoy hassle-free kitesurfing with boat transfers to spots and authentic Sri Lankan food at Ruuk Village. Our eco-friendly huts offer relaxation and a social vibe, with only 10 cabanas for a cozy feel. Meals served year-round at the beach hut. Experience kitesurfing and unwind at our Kalpitiya kiteschool. Book the No Worries Package for an unforgettable adventure.</p><h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Accommodation Fee</h3><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">41.25€ per person on double occupancy.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Single occupancy: 54.00€</p></li></ul><h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Includes</h3><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Three meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner) included. </p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Free tea, coffee, and water provided. </p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Stand-up paddleboards available for use in the lagoon. </p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Boat rides to kiting area included. </p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Housekeeping with fresh towels and linen, Turn down service. </p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Private shower and shared toilet.dhering to our no plastic policy, we opt for 20L water refills instead of bottles. </p></li></ul><h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Important </h3><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">We provide CORE kites and CrazyFly boards <a href="/kalpitiya-kite-gear-rentals">for rent at our kiteschool</a>.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><a href="/things-to-do-in-kalpitiya" target="">Discover various activities</a> in Kalpitiya beyond kitesurfing during your visit.</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Cost includes taxes and fees.</p></li></ul><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">&nbsp;</p></div>
